title: Low-Depth, Low-Complexity S-Boxes Beyond Three Bits
summary: The AND depth and multiplicative complexity of cipher constructions remain poorly understood; construct and characterize larger-than-three-bit S-boxes with low values for either or both.

formal_statement.body: For S-boxes larger than three bits, construct and characterize designs with low $\operatorname{AND}$ depth, low multiplicative complexity, or both. The broader gap is that the $\operatorname{AND}$ depth and multiplicative complexity of cipher constructions are currently poorly understood.

scope.domain: Design and analysis of nonlinear S-box components for cipher constructions.
parameters: S-box size: restricted to more than three bits
AND depth: circuit-depth efficiency measure to keep low
Multiplicative complexity: circuit-complexity measure to keep low
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct and characterize S-boxes larger than three bits with low AND depth, low multiplicative complexity, or both, and improve the broader understanding of these measures for cipher constructions.

progress.summary: The source presents larger-than-three-bit S-boxes with low AND depth or low multiplicative complexity as an interesting research direction. It notes that both measures are poorly understood for cipher constructions.
citation_labels: Martin R. Albrecht et al., Ciphers for MPC and FHE
